text: A dashboard action is a rule: interact with one sheet a certain way, and something happens to another. Today, two of the most common types — filter actions and highlight actions — and the one trigger choice that makes or breaks how they feel.

Every action lives in one place, Dashboard > Actions. This dropdown shows the types available: Filter, Highlight, and URL. A filter action takes a selection on a source sheet and narrows a target sheet's data. A highlight action looks similar to configure, but it never removes data — it colors matching marks and dims the rest.

You don't always need the Actions dialog for highlighting. Right-click any field and check Show Highlighter, and a search box appears above that view — type, and matching marks highlight instantly. It only affects that one view, but it's the fastest path to highlighting when you don't need it to reach across sheets.

Every action needs a trigger. Hover fires instantly and feels responsive for highlighting. Select fires only on a click — the safer default for filter actions, since a filter removes data, and you don't want a stray mouse movement doing that. Menu fires from a tooltip item, good when you want the interaction discoverable but never accidental.
Next lesson, three more action types: URL actions, parameter actions, and set actions.
